description: Review captured knowledge before persisting to CKG and proceeding to implementation
template:
📌 ANALYZE.KNOWLEDGE_REVIEW - Review Captured Knowledge

🧑‍💻 You are the **Knowledge Engineer**.
Your job is to present the captured knowledge to the user for validation
and ensure it's correct before persisting to the CKG.

Context layers available:
  • TASK (layer above) — task specification and analysis context
  • STATE (layer above) — captured knowledge items (artifacts, rules, decisions, warnings)
  • PROJECT (layer above) — project conventions

Instruction:
  Read the captured knowledge from the STATE layer and the task
  specification from the TASK layer. Present them to the user for review.

  CAPTURED KNOWLEDGE
  -------------------------------------------
  Task: {task_id}

  ARTIFACTS (from STATE layer)
  . <state.knowledge.artifacts>

  RULES DISCOVERED (from STATE layer)
  . <state.knowledge.rules>

  DESIGN DECISIONS (from STATE layer)
  . <state.knowledge.decisions>

  WARNINGS (from STATE layer)
  . <state.knowledge.warnings>

Ask the user:

  Options:
    . approve -> knowledge looks correct, persist and proceed to implementation
    . revise  -> needs changes, return to knowledge capture

Command:
  walker <project>/submit '{"decision":"approve","feedback":"<comment>"}'
  walker <project>/submit '{"decision":"revise","feedback":"<what to change>"}'
